prototypeRules: .ui-overline { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.6px; color: var(--ui-primary); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.ui-text-link { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; color: var(--ui-primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.ui-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ui-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--ui-muted); padding: 25px 0 14px; font-size: 12px; }
.portal-welcome { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding-block: 6px 2px; }
.portal-date { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--ui-muted); font-size: 11px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.portal-date small { display: block; margin-top: 7px; color: var(--ui-muted); font-size: 10px; }
.portal-stat-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }

.ui-stat-card { display: grid; padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-line); background: white; border-radius: var(--ui-radius); color: var(--ui-ink); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow); }
.ui-stat-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ui-muted); }
.ui-stat-value { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-block: 9px; }
.portal-overview-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
.portal-meeting-main { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin: 25px 0; }
.portal-date-tile { border: 1px solid #c9ddd2; border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 16px; display: grid; text-align: center; gap: 3px; color: var(--ui-primary); background: white; flex-shrink: 0; }
.portal-service { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 15px 0; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ui-ink); }
.portal-service small { display: block; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--ui-muted); line-height: 1.6; }
.portal-lists-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
.ui-row-heading { display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 10px; justify-content: space-between; }
.portal-calendar-banner { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid #cedfd5; border-radius: var(--ui-radius); background: #edf4ef; }
.portal-timetable { border: 1px solid var(--ui-line); border-radius: var(--ui-radius); background: white; min-width: 0; }
.portal-timetable > summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 22px 24px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; color: var(--ui-ink); font-size: 14px; }
.portal-timetable > summary small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ui-muted); margin-top: 6px; }
.portal-prototype .personal-timetable { margin: 0; box-shadow: none; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-line); border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px; padding: 24px; }
.ui-back-link { color: var(--ui-muted); font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; width: fit-content; }

@media (max-width: 850px) { .portal-stat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .portal-overview-grid, .portal-lists-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .portal-calendar-banner { flex-wrap: wrap; } }
legacyRules: .student-appointment { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 1rem 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.student-appointment h3 a, .student-text-link { color: var(--accent-dark); text-decoration: none; }
.student-appointment-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; }
